items.title: U.S. gas prices fall below $4 for the first time since July
items.summary: Americans may finally find some relief at the pump. The national average price of regular gasoline fell below $4 a gallon for the first time since July, reaching $3.9788 on Tuesday, according to AAA .

items.title: Polymarket says annualized revenue has topped $1.8 billion
items.summary: Prediction market platform Polymarket has surpassed $1.8 billion in annualized revenue, the company told CNBC on Tuesday.

items.title: Fed Governor Waller sees December hike likely, opens door to possible half-point increase
items.summary: Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller said Tuesday the central bank needs to follow through on expectations for additional interest rate hikes or risk its credibility, even suggesting that a larger-than-usual half-percentage-point increase could be warranted in December.

items.title: Consumer prices rose 0.4% in October, more than expected, complicating Fed's inflation fight
items.summary: Costs for goods and services rose more than expected in October, providing fresh warning signs for the Federal Reserve in its fight to lower inflation.

items.title: China's goods surplus tops $1 trillion for a second year amid calls for Beijing to rebalance trade
items.summary: China's trade surplus topped $1 trillion this year with two months to spare, at a time when partner countries have been raising concerns over Beijing's exports that have been undercutting local industries.
